The structure of Dy6Bi8Mo2 (Dy3Bi4Mo) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 11 or 12 geometric neighbors, Dy centers with 11 or 12 neighbors, and Mo centers with 10 neighbors, the latter forming a close-packed-like local arrangement. The neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between 10-vertex Mo and 11-vertex Dy polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 11-vertex Dy and 12-vertex Bi polyhedra.
